description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:416-422: `pub struct Verifier<'a, V, R, A = NoAiaFetcher>` carries only `&'a` references. It is logically a small copyable handle, but no derives are present. Consequences: (1) callers cannot clone the verifier into multiple threads from a single construction, (2) cannot Debug-print it during diagnostics. AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 requires cache-friendly types and the docstring at line 408-415 actively promotes the cache-friendly design — callers will want to clone the Verifier handle into multiple worker tasks. Per AGENTS.md framing this is a prelaunch design completeness issue: add #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug)] now. (Note: the Send + Sync compile-time assertion at lines 1538-1541 only asserts Error; add an analogous assertion for Verifier<'_, DefaultVerifier, NoRevocation, NoAiaFetcher> so 'Verifier is Send+Sync when its generic parameters are' is a tested invariant.)
title: Verifier struct missing Clone/Copy/Debug derives
